minutes_text:
CITY OF BEVERLY HILLS
  455 North Rexford Drive
  Beverly Hills, CA 90210
  Video Teleconference
  The Beverly Hills City Council Liaison / Rodeo Drive/Special Events/Holiday
  Program Committee Meeting

  SPECIAL MEETING HIGHLIGHTS

  Tuesday, August 27, 2024
  4:00 PM

MEETING CALLED TO ORDER
Date / Time:  August 27, 2024 / 4:00 PM
IN ATTENDANCE:  Mayor Lester Friedman, Councilmember Mary Wells, Assistant City
  Manager Keith Sterling, Community Outreach Manager Magdalena Davis,
  Rodeo Drive Committee President Kay Monica Rose

  1) Public Comment:

  None

  2) Updated Proposal from the Rodeo Drive Committee for the 2024 Rodeo Drive
  Holiday Lighting Celebration on November 14, 2024:
  a. Presentation by Kay Monica Rose:
  i. Two options for street banners were presented that considered the
  Liaison’s concerns from the last meeting. The only difference between the
  two options is the placement of the ribbon on the solo banner.
  ii. The Mains stage will be on Brighton at the intersection with Rodeo.
  iii. The 400 Block of Rodeo will have a wine garden and an LED screen
  showing the stage.
  iv. Food trucks, seating areas, and community booths will be present on the
  300 block of Rodeo.
  v. The 200 Block will have a wine garden, seating areas, and an LED screen
  showing the stage.
  vi. There will be numerous performers for all ages from 5 PM to 8:15 PM.
  vii. There is an option to have a headliner or a drone swarm. Neither are
  included due to the costs of each.
  viii. Holiday themed music will be played on Rodeo from Thursday to Sunday
  every week from November 15th through January 5th.
  ix. The Holiday Lighting Celebration will cost $1,028,966, which is a 2.76%
  from 2023.
  b. The Council Liaisons selected option A for the street banners.
  c. The Liaisons support the overall layout of the event, including the stage location.
  d. Neither Liaison is supportive of adding a headliner or the drone show.
 Highlights for August 12, 2024
Rodeo Drive/Special Events/Holiday Program Committee

  3) Update to Holiday Schedule – Menorah Lighting Event:
  a. Presentation by Magdalena Davis:
  i. The City Council wanted to revise the originally recommended date of
  Friday, December 27th due to Shabbat conflicting with the event.
  ii. The 25th and 26th are right after Christmas and so are unworkable for staff.
  b. The GEM Center is having their Menorah Lighting on the 29th.
  c. Both Liaisons support having the event on December 30th.

  4) Adjournment:
  Date / Time: August 27, 2024 / 4:51 PM
